mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND room_status IN ('occupied', 'has_stay')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM community_device WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND device_status = '1'

SELECT CASE WHEN complaint_suggest_type IN ('Complaint', 'complaint', '投诉') THEN 'Complaint' WHEN complaint_suggest_type IN ('Suggest', 'suggest', '建议') THEN 'Suggest' ELSE complaint_suggest_type END AS complaintSuggestType, complaint_suggest_content AS content FROM complaint_suggest WHERE community_id = #{communityId} AND complaint_suggest_content IS NOT NULL AND complaint_suggest_content != '' AND create_time >= #{beginTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}

SELECT pr.in_time AS inTime, pr.out_time AS outTime, pr.record_type AS recordType, pr.vehicle_id AS vehicleId FROM community_parking_record pr
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_vehicle v INNER JOIN room r ON r.room_id = v.room_id WHERE v.vehicle_id = pr.vehicle_id AND r.community_id = #{communityId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM owner_room od INNER JOIN room r ON r.room_id = od.room_id WHERE od.owner_id = pr.owner_id AND r.community_id = #{communityId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_parking_space ps WHERE ps.space_id = pr.space_id AND ps.community_id = #{communityId} ) )
AND pr.in_time < #{end} AND (pr.out_time IS NULL OR pr.out_time > #{begin})

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.in_time, '%Y%m%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM community_parking_record pr
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_vehicle v INNER JOIN room r ON r.room_id = v.room_id WHERE v.vehicle_id = pr.vehicle_id AND r.community_id = #{communityId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM owner_room od INNER JOIN room r ON r.room_id = od.room_id WHERE od.owner_id = pr.owner_id AND r.community_id = #{communityId} ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM community_parking_space ps WHERE ps.space_id = pr.space_id AND ps.community_id = #{communityId} ) )
AND pr.in_time >= #{beginDate} AND pr.in_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pr.in_time, '%Y%m%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(pr.in_time, '%Y%m%d')
